title: Github Copilot customers report up to 100-fold price hikes — AI sticker shock bites as Microsoft switches to usage-based pricing | Tom's Hardware

facts.fact: Tom's Hardware published the article on GitHub Copilot price increases on 3 June 2026.
According to customer reports cited in the headline, some GitHub Copilot customers saw price hikes of up to 100-fold as Microsoft switched to usage-based pricing.
facts.quote: Github Copilot customers report up to 100-fold price hikes

facts.fact: The article reports that Microsoft is switching GitHub Copilot to usage-based pricing.
facts.quote: as Microsoft switches to usage-based pricing
